description: This file defines a factory class for creating various types of Result objects used in the persistent actors component of the Ditto services. It provides methods to generate mutation results, error results, query results, and an empty result singleton, encapsulating common result creation patterns.

classes.name: ResultFactory
classes.description: A utility class providing static factory methods for creating various Result instances related to command execution and event processing within the persistent actors context.

methods.name: newMutationResult
methods.description: Creates a Result representing a successful mutation, including the command, event, response headers, and flags indicating creation or deletion behavior.

methods.name: newErrorResult
methods.description: Creates a Result representing an error state, encapsulating the thrown DittoRuntimeException and the command that caused it.

methods.name: newQueryResult
methods.description: Creates a Result representing a query response, including the command and response headers.

methods.name: emptyResult
methods.description: Returns a singleton instance of an empty Result, indicating no content or operation.
